name: Docker Build

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - beta
      - next
      - io
    tags:
      - '*'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - beta
      - next
      - io

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        variant: [main, beta, next, io]
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write
    env:
      REGISTRY: ghcr.io
      IMAGE_NAME: misskeyio/misskey
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Login to GitHub Container Registry
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Build and push Docker image
        if: ${{ github.ref_type == 'tag' || github.ref_name == matrix.variant }}
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
        with:
          context: .
          file: Dockerfile
          push: true
          tags: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}:${{ github.ref_name }}
          cache-from: type=gha,scope=${{ matrix.variant }}-${{ github.ref_name }}
          cache-to: type=gha,scope=${{ matrix.variant }}-${{ github.ref_name }}
          build-args: |
            CI=true
          labels: |
            org.opencontainers.image.source=${{ github.repository_url }}
          platforms: linux/amd64,linux/arm64
